visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The shot opens on a double bed with crisp white linens and a charcoal-and-light-grey striped bed runner. A wooden headboard is visible, integrated with a bedside lamp that has a warm, vintage glow. On the wall, framed black-and-white photographs of urban scenes are arranged neatly. The room has a modern but retro aesthetic, with a small desk area featuring a dark wood chair and a classic desk lamp. A large window allows bright, natural daylight to fill the space, illuminating the beige carpet and light grey walls. (2) The scene transitions to a well-stocked bar. Multiple rows of whiskey and liquor bottles, including brands like The Glenlivet, Macallan, and Yamazaki, are displayed on backlit glass shelves. A close-up shows a tall glass of orange-colored liquid, likely a cocktail or juice, placed on a dark countertop next to a glowing brass lamp. The lighting in this area is moody and sophisticated, contrasting with the bright hotel room. (3) Close-ups of various hotel amenities and details follow. A hand flips two white toggle light switches on a beige plate. A circular brass key tag engraved with "Room 718" and "Hotel The Knot Yokohama" is held up. Canvas tote bags with the text "BLOW HIGH, BLOW LOW, JUST BE YOURSELF" hang from hooks on a light grey wall next to a flat-screen TV. The bathroom is shown briefly, featuring white fixtures, a compact layout, and neatly arranged toiletries. (4) The final shots show the exterior and lobby of the hotel. A large glass entrance features the sign "THE KNOT". Inside the lobby, a mural on a brick wall depicts a cartoon man in a tuxedo with the text "WELCOME TO HOTEL THE KNOT MAKE YOURSELVES AT HOME". The lobby area is furnished with marble-topped tables and wooden chairs, maintaining the vintage, "hipster" vibe emphasized throughout the video.
